item.title: Local Wikipedia: Wikipedia, but only for things a half hour walk from you
item.description:
📝 Local Wikipedia is Wikipedia, but only for things a half hour walk from you. Local content is direct from Wikipedia - geocoded pages only. If there are more than 500 things only the closest 500 will be included.
🔗 Read more: https://edjefferson.com/localwiki/
